This looks good to me.  I think the +1 was because there is always at least 1 byte before the string starts (with extension + optional bits).  But search loop is there because length can vary depending upon which ranFunctionDefinition applies..

Ah okay so since normally the RANfunctionDefinition would contain more ASN1 encoded data, the shortName would only start in the second byte? I am not sure if that changes anything about the + 1 being unnecessary. But I am happy to go back and add it in if you think we should keep it
I think do please add it in so that we don't do a check that will not pass.
